title: OSDisk
description: Specifies information about the operating system disk used by the virtual machine.

osType.description: This property allows you to specify the type of the OS that is included in the disk.

createOption.description: Specifies how the virtual machine disk should be created.

diskSizeGB.description: Specifies the size of an empty data disk in gigabytes.

deleteOption.description: Specifies whether OS disk should be deleted or detached upon VM deletion.
